==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill upon entering combat, however, they will not recast it unless they have moved out of spirit range or if the spirit has died.

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Blood Song]] that uses the [[Bloodsong (attack)|Bloodsong]] attack skill.
* The attacks made by the Spirit of Blood Song steal health from its [[target]] for its own benefit, not for the benefit of the player who spawned the spirit.
** Since the Spirit of Blood Song [[heal]]s itself, it is a prime candidate for use with [[Spirit Transfer]].
* Combine with [[Spiritleech Aura]] to gain additional life stealing.
* The attacks used by this spirit steal health, so it does not receive the bonus damage from [[Signet of Ghostly Might]].

== Trivia ==
* Bloodsong was originally a [[Communing]] skill, but was moved to [[Channeling Magic]] in the [[Game updates/20070201|February 1st, 2007 update]].
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
